column2: Many young families invest a small part of their salary in index funds every month.
column3: 許多年輕家庭每個月把一小部分薪水投資在指數型基金上。
column5: in 放進 + vest：把錢放進去，等它長大

column2: One private investor agreed to fund the start-up's first production line.
column3: 一位私人投資人同意出資給這家新創公司的第一條生產線。
column5: invest 投資 + or 人：投錢的那個人

column2: My retirement savings are held in a mutual fund that tracks the Taiwan market.
column3: 我的退休存款放在一檔追蹤台灣市場的共同基金裡。
column4: invest in a mutual fund (投資共同基金)
column5: mutual 互相 + fund 基金：大家湊錢互相分擔

column2: A hedge fund bet heavily against the retailer, expecting its share price to fall.
column3: 一檔避險基金大舉押注零售商的股價會下跌。
column4: manage a hedge fund (管理避險基金)
column5: hedge 樹籬：用籬笆把風險圍起來

column2: The start-up raised venture capital to hire engineers and open a second office.
column3: 這家新創公司募得創投資金，用來聘請工程師並開設第二間辦公室。
column4: raise venture capital (募集創投資金)
column5: venture 冒險 + capital 資本：敢冒險的錢

column2: An angel investor gave the two founders enough money to build their first app.
column3: 一位天使投資人給了兩位創辦人足夠的錢來開發第一個應用程式。
column4: find an angel investor (找到天使投資人)
column5: angel 天使從天而降，在你最需要時送錢來

column2: Underwriting a new policy requires checking the applicant's health and driving records.
column3: 承保一份新保單需要審核申請人的健康與駕駛紀錄。
column5: under 下面 + write 寫：在風險下面簽上名字

column2: Three banks agreed to underwrite the company's new share offering.
column3: 三家銀行同意承銷公司新發行的股票。
column5: under 下面 + write 寫：簽名在下方，就要負責

column2: They took out a thirty-year mortgage to buy their first apartment.
column3: 他們辦了三十年的房貸來買下第一間公寓。
column4: pay off a mortgage (還清房貸)
column5: mort 死 + gage 抵押：貸款還清，這份債就「消失」了

column2: The bank accepted the warehouse as collateral for the business loan.
column3: 銀行接受這間倉庫作為企業貸款的擔保品。
column5: col 一起 + lateral 側邊：東西站在貸款旁邊當保障

column2: A lower interest rate makes it cheaper for small firms to borrow money.
column3: 較低的利率讓小公司借錢的成本更低。
column4: raise the interest rate (調高利率)
column5: interest 利息 + rate 比率：借錢付出的百分比

column2: Each monthly payment covers part of the principal and part of the interest.
column3: 每個月的還款一部分用來還本金，一部分用來付利息。
column5: principal 校長是你的 pal；principle 原則像 rule

column2: The maturity of the bond is five years, so investors will be paid back in 2031.
column3: 這張債券的到期日是五年後，所以投資人會在2031年拿回本金。
column5: mature 成熟 + ity：果子熟了，債券也熟了該收

column2: The government bonds will mature in June, and investors will receive their full payment.
column3: 這些政府債券將於六月到期，投資人將領回全額款項。
column5: mature 像「妹吹」：妹妹吹完生日蠟燭就長大成熟了

column2: Retirees often buy government bonds because they pay a steady, low-risk income.
column3: 退休人士常購買政府公債，因為它們提供穩定而低風險的收入。
column5: bond 像「綁」：債券把借的人和貸的人綁在一起

column2: The guard checked my badge at the door as part of building security.
column3: 警衛在門口檢查我的識別證，這是大樓安保的一部分。
column5: se 無 + cure 擔憂：沒有擔心就是安全

column2: The company issued new securities to raise funds for the factory.
column3: 公司發行新的證券來為工廠籌措資金。
column5: security 的複數：很多張有價證券

column2: Shares of the airline rose sharply on the stock exchange after the merger news.
column3: 合併消息公布後，這家航空公司的股價在證券交易所大漲。
column4: list on the stock exchange (在證交所上市)
column5: stock 股票 + exchange 交換：大家在這裡買賣換股票

column2: A broker helped the couple compare insurance plans and choose the cheapest one.
column3: 一位經紀人幫助這對夫妻比較保險方案並挑選最便宜的一個。
column5: broker 像「不老客」：幫客人交易的中間人

column2: The brokerage charges a small fee each time a customer buys shares.
column3: 這家經紀商每當客戶買股時，都會收取一小筆費用。
column5: broker 經紀人 + age 機構：經紀人開的公司

column2: Sales staff earn a ten percent commission on every contract they close.
column3: 業務人員每成交一份合約就能賺取百分之十的佣金。
column5: com 一起 + mission 任務：完成任務才分你一份

column2: Each transaction is recorded automatically so the accountants can review it later.
column3: 每筆交易都會自動記錄，讓會計人員稍後可以檢閱。
column5: trans 跨越 + act 行動：錢從一方跨到另一方

column2: The firm lacks liquidity, so it cannot pay suppliers until customers settle their bills.
column3: 這家公司缺乏流動資金，所以在客戶付清帳款前無法付給供應商。
column5: liquid 液體 + ity：錢像水一樣流得動

column2: Cash is the most liquid asset because you can spend it immediately.
column3: 現金是流動性最高的資產，因為你可以立刻花掉它。
column5: liquid 液體像水能流，資產也能快速流成現金

column2: The retailer's insolvency left dozens of suppliers waiting for unpaid invoices.
column3: 零售商的無力償債讓數十家供應商苦等未付的發票款項。
column5: in 不 + solv 解開：債務解不開，還不了

column2: The court declared the construction firm insolvent after it failed to repay its debts.
column3: 法院在這家建設公司無法償還債務後，宣告其無力清償。
column5: in 不 + solvent 能還錢的：還不了錢

column2: The airline went bankrupt after three years of heavy losses.
column3: 這家航空公司在連續三年重大虧損後破產了。
column5: bank 銀行 + rupt 斷裂：銀行的錢路斷了

column2: If the borrower defaults on the loan, the bank can claim the collateral.
column3: 如果借款人違約不還款，銀行可以收回擔保品。
column4: default on a loan (貸款違約)
column5: de 不 + fault 錯誤：該還沒還，就是出錯了

column2: Strong creditworthiness allowed the firm to borrow money at a lower rate.
column3: 良好的信用度讓這家公司能以較低的利率借到錢。
column5: credit 信用 + worthy 值得 + ness：值得被信任的程度

column2: A better credit rating means the city can sell bonds at a lower cost.
column3: 較好的信用評等代表這座城市能以更低的成本發行債券。
column4: a high credit rating (高信用評等)
column5: credit 信用 + rating 評分：給信用打分數

column2: Our risk management team reviews every overseas contract before it is signed.
column3: 我們的風險管理團隊在每份海外合約簽署前都會審閱。
column4: risk management plan (風險管理計畫)
column5: risk 風險 + management 管理：把風險管起來

column2: Hedging against currency changes protects exporters from sudden drops in revenue.
column3: 針對匯率變動進行避險，可以保護出口商不因收入驟減而受損。
column5: hedge 樹籬：用籬笆把風險擋在外面

column2: Experts warned that speculation in housing had pushed prices far above real value.
column3: 專家警告說，房市的投機炒作已把價格推到遠高於實際價值。
column5: spec 看 + ulation：只靠「看」行情賭一把

column2: Speculative investments can bring high profits, but they also carry a real chance of loss.
column3: 投機性的投資可能帶來高額利潤，但也有真正的虧損可能。
column5: speculation 投機 + ive：形容賭一把的性質

column2: Fuel prices fluctuate during the year, so budgets are often revised in the autumn.
column3: 燃料價格全年都在波動，所以預算常在秋季修訂。
column5: fluct 流動：像波浪一樣上下流動

column2: Investors dislike volatility because sharp price swings make planning difficult.
column3: 投資人不喜歡劇烈波動，因為價格大幅起伏讓規畫變得困難。
column5: volat 飛 + ility：價格像小鳥忽高忽低亂飛

column2: Our marketing strategy focuses on small businesses that have never used online ads.
column3: 我們的行銷策略鎖定從未使用過網路廣告的小型企業。
column5: strategy 像「死抓得雞」：抓好大計畫才能贏

column2: Choosing a site near the port was a strategic decision for the logistics firm.
column3: 選擇靠近港口的地點，對這家物流公司而言是一項具戰略性的決定。
column5: strategy 策略 + ic：形容和大計畫有關

column2: The chief strategist suggested entering the Southeast Asian market before competitors arrived.
column3: 首席策略師建議在競爭者進入之前先打入東南亞市場。
column5: strategy 策略 + ist 專家：想大計畫的專家

column2: Our main objective this quarter is to reduce delivery delays by half.
column3: 我們這一季的主要目標是把送貨延遲減少一半。
column5: object 物體：把箭頭對準的靶就是目標
